fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) has risen 13% following CoreWeave (CRWV)'s strong results announcement, with CoreWeave posting Q3 loss per share of $1.27 (better than expected) and revenue of $3.66 billion (exceeding expectations).
fields.summary_ko.1: CoreWeave raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0-13.3 billion, with capital investment plans of $37-39 billion expected to drive SanDisk memory chip demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: CoreWeave expects annualized run-rate revenue of $20-21 billion (as of end of 2026) and commits to achieving profitability by early 2028, while SanDisk trades at below 7x trailing earnings and below 4x forward earnings, indicating undervaluation.
